mentions.description: An in-progress migration of the author's personal infrastructure to a more well-documented setup. They have moved the authoritative DNS zones for some of their domains into Terraform and are still working on related Ansible setups, describing the effort as overkill but a valuable learning exercise.
mentions.problem: Previously the author set up infrastructure and 'hoped for the best' without documentation; the project addresses making the setup well documented and reproducible.
mentions.author: ibfreeekout
